queries.result: The official City government states its digitized cadastral maps show land within the city; the Assessor’s Charter offers a certified tax-map copy request and real-property services. No anonymous vector map API was identified.

queries.query: Dagupan mapa kadastral opisyal City Assessor cadastral map tax map
queries.result: The official city pages and charter evidence a local City Assessor and digitized cadastral maps, but describe map access as an assessor document request rather than a public vector service.

portals.observation: Official city physical profile attributes its area statement to City Assessor records and says digitized cadastral maps reveal the land within Dagupan city boundaries.

City Assessor Citizen’s Charter assigns real-property assessment locally and describes tax-map copies by formal data request; some assessor services require a request and fees (including a PHP200-per-parcel service). No map data or property details were retrieved.
Official City website links to Online Real Estate Property Tax service; the linked taxpayer service is an account-based property-tax workflow, not a public cadastral geometry endpoint.
